[EN] I don't know if Intrepid will fly again. The engines took a lot of damage in the attack and the fall from the sky didn't do the much good.

Still, they got us here. I like them for that.
[ES] No sé si el Intrepid volverá a volar. Los motores sufrieron muchos daños en el ataque y la caída del cielo no les sentó nada bien.

Aun así, nos trajeron aquí. Se lo agradezco.
